description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

description:
A corruptive presence has invaded the Federal Bureau of Control… Only you have the power to stop it. The world is now your weapon in an epic fight to annihilate an ominous enemy through deep and unpredictable environments. Containment has failed, humanity is at stake. Will you regain control?


Winner of over 80 awards, CONTROL is a visually stunning third-person action-adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Blending open-ended environments with the signature world-building and storytelling of renowned developer, Remedy Entertainment, CONTROL presents an expansive and intensely gratifying gameplay experience.


CONTROL Ultimate Edition has now been adapted to iOS. We have implemented touch controls and made changes to the in-game UI and game mechanics, like aiming and puzzles to provide a great experience for supported touch devices. The game renders beautifully through Metal and supports Ray Tracing on supported hardware.



Key features


UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES: Can you handle the bureau’s dark secrets? Unfold an epic supernatural struggle, filled with unexpected characters and bizarre events, as you search for your missing brother, and discover the truth that has brought you here.



EVERYTHING IS YOUR WEAPON: Unleash destruction through transforming weaponry and telekinetic powers. Discover new ways to annihilate your enemies as you harness powerful abilities to turn everything around you into a lethal weapon.



EXPLORE A HIDDEN WORLD: Delve deep into the ominous expanses of a secretive government agency. Explore the Bureau’s shifting environments only to discover that there is always more than meets the eye…



FIGHT FOR CONTROL: Battle a relentless enemy through exciting missions and challenging boss fights to earn powerful upgrades that maximize abilities and customize your weaponry.


CONTROL Ultimate Edition on iOS supports the following MetalFX features:

MetalFX TAAU - Temporal Anti-Aliasing and upscaling
MetalFX Frame Interpolation

Ray-Tracing is supported on devices with M3+ or A19 Pro with 10Gb of memory.
releaseNotes:
Further updates have been done to the initial Asset Pack logic and added ray tracing support for M3+ iPads with 10Gb of memory.

In an apocalyptic world overrun by the undead, where the fate of humanity hangs in the balance amid diminishing living spaces, will you rise as the hero we need to reshape the destiny of humankind? Uncover the adventure of Last Z: Survival Shooter – your destiny awaits!

Dodge & Shoot

description:
All in Hole is the oddly satisfying black-hole puzzle where you guide Molly the mole on a snack-swallowing adventure. Slide a tiny hole, devour small objects to grow, and use playful physics to gobble every target treat. Whether you’re here to zen out or chase trophies, All in Hole serves up quick, colorful levels that feel great to master.

Why you’ll love it
- Smooth, tactile physics — swipe, scoop, and watch the hole snap up anything in its path
- Smart goals — sort and swallow only what’s required to clear the puzzle
- Relax or compete — chill at your own pace or enter limited-time tournaments and climb the leaderboard
- Team up — join a crew to chat, share hearts and coins, and earn sweet bonuses together
- Yummy progression — collect ingredients, unlock recipes, and decorate cakes
- Handy boosts — grab energy and time helpers for tough stages
- Fresh drops — regular events and new levels

How to play
- Drag to move the black hole
- Eat small items to grow larger
- Swallow the target treats to finish the level

Tips from Molly
- Look ahead: plan a clean route so you don’t block yourself
- Prioritize: gulp the light stuff first, then the big bites

All in Hole wraps strategic puzzles, cozy vibes, and competitive thrills into one satisfying experience. Help Molly become the ultimate hole master — then keep collecting, decorating, and teaming up for bonuses. Ready to relax and swallow the challenge? Jump in now!

The original Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp game was released in 2017. This new one-time purchase app is packed with items and events that were released over the course of seven years. It keeps the general game play of Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp without additional in-game purchases.

As a campsite manager, it's up to you to build a fun campsite. While working as the manager, you can also fish, catch bugs, chat with animals, and collect your favorite furniture.
You can also change into your favorite outfit, make lots of detours, and enjoy your relaxing camp life!

◆ Decorate your campsite with over 10,000 items
From tents and swings to lazy rivers and merry-go-rounds, there are tons of items you can use to decorate your campsite with to your taste.

◆ Meet the animals
A lot of animals with quirky personalities will make an appearance. The animals are very curious about your campsite. The animal pal you choose as a camp caretaker will help you with your job. Walk around the forest together and get inspiration on how to build a lovely campsite.

◆ Tons of seasonal events
There will be lots of events such as Garden Events and Fishing Tourneys every month. Don't forget Halloween, Toy Day, Bunny Day, and the Summer Festival. Jump into these events to collect seasonal items.

==========New Game Play Added to the Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete Game==========

◆ Camper Cards
You can create a Camper Card that introduces you. Pick a color and pose and it's done. You can also scan other players' Camper Cards and enjoy trading and collecting. 

◆ Gatherings at the Whistle Pass
You can visit a new place that didn't exist in Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp. Other players whose Camper Cards you registered will come visit. Enjoy music, with a nightly live guitar performance by K.K. Slider.

◆ Complete Ticket
When you participate in events, you can earn Complete Tickets. Exchange them for limited-edition items that you missed out on or fortune cookies of your choice.

◆ Enjoy Custom Designs
You can scan Custom Designs created in the Animal Crossing: New Horizons game for the Nintendo Switch system, then wear or otherwise use them in the app.

description:
► Hex-traordinary Fun

Looking for a simple yet difficult puzzle that will both help you relax AND train your brain? Color Slide is your one stop shop for all of that and more! Sort and color match hexagons across the playing field, merging colors and making room for more pieces to appear. As you do so your stress will just slip away!

► Hex-cellent Work 

What might seem simple at first gets progressively more difficult and challenging as you progress and more colors of hexagons appear, and the playing field changes shape to make maneuvers trickier. And yet, you’ll soon find yourself feeling cool as a cucumber and less stressed as you focus on the puzzle and not on life’s frustrations. So get ready for some color sorting fun and dive right into this delightfully colorful mindgame!

► Hex-ational Features

Progressive difficulty – With each level this color puzzle becomes more and more difficult. Multi colored blocks, new colors, funky shaped playing fields, and more will force you to really slow down and focus in order to properly organize all the hexagons by color and win the round. As soon as you master one skill you’ll be presented with a new one to keep things exciting!

Ageless entertainment – Whether you’re 5 or 95, you’ll be able to happily play this brain game. With no timer and no penalties you can try levels over and over again until you get them right if need be, or put the game down for a bit and come back later to keep trying.

Chill graphics – No bouncy shapes, excessive vibrations, or explosions of color – we created this game to help you relax and that means simple but enjoyable graphics so that your eyes and brain aren’t distracted. This also makes the game great for kids since they won’t get overstimulated by all the crazy images.

Relaxing gameplay – In keeping with the graphics, the game in general is built around the goal of helping you let go of stress. Stop and start at any moment, and don’t fret about points or goals. Just kick back and relax, and help your mind relax as you focus on the simple task of sorting colored hexagons.

► Hexagon-a be Great

Casual players and puzzle aficionados alike will adore this relaxing logic puzzle game. With no countdown clock or penalties, you can take your time carefully matching up the colored tiles to clear the board as you also clear your mind. Before you know if you’ll be a color master, whizzing through levels with ease even as they get progressively more challenging – download Color Slide today to get matching and relaxing!

description:
Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.

FEATURES
- Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.
- Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games.
- A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production.
- A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience.

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max)

description:
Embark on an epic journey with Age of History 3, which takes you through the vast timeline of human history. From the Age of Civilization to the realms of the far future, play as various Civilizations ranging from dominant empires to small tribes.

Technology
Advance in the technology tree to unlock better buildings and stronger units, improving your Civilization. Each technological breakthrough opens up new possibilities, reflecting the evolution and growth of your Civilization through History.

Army Composition
The choice of units in the front and second line is vital. Front-line units need to be resilient and capable of dealing with direct combat, while second-line units should provide support, range attacks, or specialized functions.
With more than 63 unique unit types available, you have a vast array of army compositions to select from, offering a diverse range of strategic options.

New Battle System
Each day, the front-line units of both armies engage in combat with the enemy's front-line, provided they are within attack range. Simultaneously, the second-line units also participate by attacking the enemy's front-line units if they fall within their range.
The combat results in casualties, the retreat of troops, and the loss of morale.

Manpower
Manpower represents the stock of individuals eligible for military service within a Civilization. It is a critical resource used for recruiting new troops and reinforcing existing armies, embodying the Civilization's capacity to wage war and defend itself.
Manpower replenishes over time, reflecting natural population growth and recovery from previous military engagements.
Since manpower replenishes over time, players must plan their military campaigns considering their current and future manpower availability.

description:
Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns to iOS in Hitman: Absolution.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments that reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s happy hunting ground.

Expertly adapted for mobile play, Absolution’s sleek touchscreen controls offer 47’s hallmark precision, with gamepad and keyboard & mouse support included for the full AAA experience on the go.

SIGNATURE STYLE
Blend into the background, kill silently, and disappear without trace, or go in all guns blazing! Absolution’s missions invite you to experiment, improvise and perfect your technique.

COMPLETE CONTROL
Customise touch controls until they fit you like a glove, or connect a gamepad or any keyboard & mouse that is compatible with iPadOS.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
The story of Absolution puts Agent 47’s character under the spotlight, where both his loyalties and his conscience are put to the test.

KILLER INSTINCT
Use Instinct Mode to identify targets, predict enemy movement, and highlight points of interest.

CLEAR YOUR PATH
Use Point Shooting to stop time, mark multiple enemies, and eliminate them in a heartbeat.

MASTER THE CRAFT
Find new ways to take out your marks, complete Challenges, or take the ultimate test in Purist mode, with deadlier enemies and no help to guide you.

CONTRACTS MODE
Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.

===

We recommend playing Hitman: Absolution on iOS 18 or later. You need 12GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

Ignite engines, buckle up, and now dive into the epic sci-fi universe of Isaac Asimov’s Foundation—the beloved novels that also inspired the acclaimed Apple TV+ series.

Immersive Story: The Master Trader's Galactic Odyssey

Seldon’s Plan and confronting with the mysterious enemy the Mule.

description:
Enter the world of "Tiles Survive!" and guide your team of survivors through a harsh wilderness. As the core of your survivor team, explore the wild, gather key resources, and use them wisely to strengthen your shelter.
Venture into different tiles and expand your territory. Improve how you manage resources, build and upgrade structures, and connect electricity to speed up production. Create a self-sufficient shelter where every decision shapes your survivors’ future.

Game Features:

● Operations & Management
Enhance your production structures for smoother workflows. Use electricity to run your shelter more efficiently. Unlock and upgrade more structures to meet your growing needs.

● Assign Survivors
Assign jobs to your survivors, like hunters, chefs, or lumberjacks. Pay attention to their health and morale to keep productivity high.

● Resource Collection
Explore further and discover unique resources in different biomes. Gather and use every resource to your advantage.

● Multi-map & Collectibles
Travel through multiple maps to find loot and special items. Bring them back to decorate and improve your shelter.

● Recruit Heroes
Find heroes with special skills and traits who boost your shelter’s capabilities.

● Form Alliances

In "Tiles Survive!", every choice matters. How you manage resources, plan your shelter, and explore the unknown will decide your fate. Are you ready to face the challenge and thrive in the wild? Download now and begin your epic adventure!

description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

releaseNotes:
[New Content]
1. Kingdom of Power Optimizations: 
Introducing "Duel of the Elites"—a new Cross-Kingdom group battle during the Preparation Phase! The top 150 Governors by Power from each Kingdom will clash in an epic showdown, competing to earn Preparation Point Boosts for their Kingdom and help secure the ultimate victory! (Please refer to the in-game rules for the official event rules.)

Warriors, assemble! The brawl begins! Whether competing in Same-Gen or Cross-Gen matches, you'll face off against other Governors on a dynamic battlefield and experience thrilling real-time combat. Strategy and execution are equally important—victory or defeat can be decided in an instant. Step onto the battlefield, prove your skill, and claim ultimate glory!

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance Optimizations:
- R5 members can now add or remove Alliance members from the whitelist on the Alliance Members screen, making member management more convenient.
- Manual input has been added to the Alliance Resource Exchange screen for more convenient exchanges.
- A Starred Notice feature and a Starred Notice tab have been added to Alliance Notices, making it easier for Governors to quickly find important notices.
- Notices can now be pinned to make important information more prominent.
- A Like/Dislike option has been added. When enabled, Alliance members can react to notices with likes or dislikes, making feedback more visible.
- Mail notifications have been added for failed gathering attempts at Secured Alliance Gathering Node, providing more timely feedback.

description:
Screwdom is a challenging and brain-teasing screw master 3D game that will put your problem-solving skills to the ultimate test. This exciting game combines the thrill of sorting with the fun of screw master 3D, offering a perfect balance of relaxation and brain-teasing action.

Why Choose Screwdom?
• Perfect for All Ages: Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore screw puzzle solver, this screw puzzle offers a perfect challenge and fun for everyone.
• Sharpen Your Brain: This screwdom puzzle will enhance your logical thinking, problem-solving, and strategy-making skills as you work your way through increasingly tricky levels.
• No Time Limits: Play at your own pace! There's no rush, so you can take your time to solve each screwdom puzzle and enjoy the process.
How to Play:
• Look at the screwdom stacked on different pins.
• Identify the color of screw master 3D that matches and move them to the correct box.
• Be mindful of the order in which you move the screwdom – one wrong move can block your progress.
• Keep sorting the screwdom until each color is placed in the corresponding box.
• Unlock more levels and enjoy endless screw puzzle.

Screwdom puzzle is not only about playing a game, it's about unlocking the world of screw puzzle. Each level is a challenge so that you can enhance your problem solving.

 Stunning models: Screwdom offers hundreds level of models from house, duck, cube, etc. You can freely discover new levels and train your mind with different unscrew strategies to be a screw master 3D.

 Continuous update: We are continuously updating new levels, 3D models and improvements to serve your best experience.
 ASMR and colorful gameplay: Click sounds from screwdom puzzle and colorful models will help you relieve stress and keep you entertained after a long working day.

Ready to dive into the world of screw, colors, and puzzles? Enjoy hours of satisfying gameplay with Screwdom.

description:
STEP UP TO THE PLATE
Relive the second baseball game in the Backyard Sports franchise, now enhanced to run on iOS. Whether you're picking your dream team, playing a pick-up game, or diving into a full season, step up to the plate and experience the game that made baseball fun for everyone!

Backyard Baseball ‘01 teams up the Backyard kids with Backyardified MLB legends. Create your own Backyard team, customize your uniforms, and strategize to win the Championship. Play a single pick-up game or play through an entire season. Backyard Baseball ‘01 features intuitive controls for all ages!

SWING BACK INTO BASEBALL
Enjoy baseball like it’s 2001!
30 Charming Backyard kids
Legendary MLB Players
MLB Team Marks
Hilarious Bloopers
8 Classic Ballparks
9 Pitching Power-ups and 4 batting Power-ups
Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Vinnie

To get into the swing of things, choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit the ball!

THE GOAT RETURNS
Play with the legend himself, Pablo Sanchez. Build a roster from a cast of 30 hilarious child athletes and 28 legendary pros that made Backyard Baseball ‘01 a sports classic. Returning MLB players include Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez, Cal Ripken Jr., Sammy Sosa, Mike Piazza, Randy Johnson, Nomar Garciaparra, Jeff Bagwell, Jason Giambi, Chipper Jones, Jeromy Burnitz, Mark McGwire, Shawn Green, Vladimir Guerrero, Kenny Lofton, Jason Kendall, Barry Larkin, Marty Cordova, Mo Vaughn, Raul Mondesi, Curt Schilling, Alex Gonzalez, Juan Gonzalez, Larry Walker, Carlos Beltran, Tony Gwynn, Ivan Rodriguez, and Jose Canseco.

Game Modes include:
Choose from three modes of play (Easy Mode, Medium Mode, Hard Mode)
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer choosing players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You pick your home field, create a team, and manage the team through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season, the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). If you keep winning, you’ll compete in the Super Entire Nation Tournament and Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series!

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.

Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries.

Backyard Baseball ‘01 runs well, looks better than ever, includes new bonus features to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！
Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
Deep strategy, but easy to jump in
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
Progress Without the Grind
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
Unique avatars, without looking the same
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

description:
NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures

Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze  with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

Breaking News: Taygedo's romance crisis! Romance and impulse, heartbreak and missed chances—Miss Tako, the object of a secret crush, is about to leave Hethereau with her guarantor. How will the lovestruck otter get his feelings across before it's too late?

Reliable Insider Tip: Film Orbit Studio is back in business! Members of the Eibon Antique Shop get exclusive discounts!

Weather Update: The Anomaly Rainman is entering an active phase—don't forget your rain gear on the way out!

That wraps up today's 10AM broadcast. Stay tuned for mysterious Anomalies, unbreakable "Oaths," and the ever-growing shadow of the colossal "Circle" organization, looming larger in the fragmented echoes of "Prophecies"...

◆ Encounters and Bonds

Explore hidden shops tucked away in back alleys and meet their enigmatic owners, along with absurdly overpowered bodyguards, "jack-of-all-trades" robotic butlers, troublemakers who can't help finding problems, and TV-headed repairmen with some very curious eating habits.

As part of the Eibon crew, you'll never be short on energetic companions for the road ahead.

Expand your social circle starting from the bustling Hankaku Street! Meet members from different factions and add them as "Bagel" friends!

From the tight-knit neighborhood of street shops to the city's unique hunter organizations, countless side stories await—ready for you to make friends and forge bonds across every corner of Hethereau.

◆ Customize Your Urban Lifestyle

Explore the city on your own terms—stick to familiar routines or shake things up.

Customize your ride and tear through the city streets, or hop on the Ghost Train to cut through Anomaly space and arrive in a flash.

In your downtime, swing by the old shops on Hankaku Street to browse their secret seasonal stock, or buy a cozy little home and deck it out to your liking.

Go at your own pace, follow your instincts, and let Hethereau reward you with colorful days worth remembering.

description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

► SORT YOUR WAY TO HAPPINESS

Master mergers, ready those fingers and get to matching in 3…2…1! This fun sorting puzzle features colorful coins that need to be matched up in their slots and then merged together to clear the playing field, making way for more. Bright colors, simple graphics, and lots of boosters ensure that your brain can focus on what it does best: noticing patterns and finding unique ways to shuffle everything around in order to win.
 
► MASTER THE MATCH

Simple in theory yet difficult in practice, players young and old will enjoy racking their brains for the best possible way to merge the different color coins and keep progressing. With no timer or pressure to trip you up, you’ll be able to sort, match, and merge the coins while also relaxing.

Fun features:

● Tons of coin types – In addition to your standard rainbow of coins to match, as you progress there will be all manner or fun new coins to keep things fresh. Hidden coins, linked coins, ice coins, and more await, so keep your eyes peeled!

● Easy on the eye – As colorful as this sorting puzzle is, the whole point is to help you chill so we’ve done away with any crazy graphics or flashing lights. This also means the game is great to play wherever you find yourself, solo or perhaps with a little helper.

● Relaxing to play – No countdown clock here! Take as much time on each puzzle as you need, and move the coins around as much as you want without being penalized. We believe in having fun, not getting stressed.

● Train your brain – Sorting and matching puzzles are a great way to train your brain to recognize patterns and colors, and to work on your logic and thinking skills as you test out different ways to group coins. And it doesn’t stop there, the skills you hone in the game can be applied to other stuff in real life.

● Keep growing – As you progress through the puzzle levels, more colors and coin types will be added, and things will get steadily more difficult. But no fear, even as you’re pushed to get better we’ve added plenty of fun boosters to keep it chill.

► GO ON A COLORFUL ADVENTURE

Ready to start your merge adventure? This relaxing game keeps your mind sharp while also providing a fun escape as you enjoy sorting and matching, so hop on in to become the master sorter and put all this stuff where it needs to be!

Download Pocket Sort: Coin Puzzle today to see how good you are at locating different colored coins and slotting them in together.

description:
Buy once. No ads. No in-app purchases.

Pokitoy is a collection of 3D fidgets and minigames for the curiosity you never outgrew.

Traditional Chinese characters gradually appear on a blank slider. With each slide, chance brings them together into words. Each discovery joins your word collection, with meanings you can read in English. An oval slider grows smooth and bright beneath your touch, until a hidden pattern comes into view. Small things keep traces of the time you spend with them.

Some discoveries invite a second look. Turn symbol dice and use the clues to rule out the wrong combinations. Flip colors to find symmetry, matching pairs, or a path you can trace in one stroke. Rotate blocks to fill a square without leaving a gap. In a shape-based sudoku, work out where each piece belongs, one row, column, and box at a time. Pick matching tiles from a layered stack, clearing them three at a time while keeping an eye on the space left in your tray.

Sometimes, play takes a musical turn. A suitcase holds drums and cymbals. A kalimba offers clear, plucked notes; a handpan rings out with a lingering tone. Strum a few chords over an accompaniment and see where they lead. There is no score to follow. The melody can be yours.

Other moments come down to a choice. Watch the pitch: swing, or let a ball outside the strike zone pass. Judge where the next platform will be, then lift your finger and leap. At the auction table, piece together the clues to a hidden lot, weigh the earlier bids, and decide whether to raise your offer or walk away. Familiar objects bring their own small challenges.

A typewriter and a radio keep a different rhythm. Follow the prompts, and a letter takes shape through steady, careful keystrokes. Send a message in Morse code to a character in a story. Wait for a reply, then choose what to say. With each exchange, the story moves on. Sometimes, a different answer leads to a different ending.

Over time, play becomes a collection of your own. Exchange coins and coupons earned along the way for more variations. Familiar toys can bring a new look, a different sound, a change in difficulty, or a new goal. Your progress page keeps track of your collection, levels, and titles, while achievements connect your discoveries across different toys. There are currently 28 toys and 50 additional variations across the collection to unlock through play—a toybox that keeps growing, one discovery at a time.

Get ready to compete with players everywhere, pushing your skills to the limit as you advance in leaderboards. When you finally join the leaderboard of top busters, every clean run and every perfectly cleared board will feel even sweeter.

Jelly Busters is your new go-to for relaxing ASMR cube action: a wildly exciting and deeply satisfying skatepark adventure filled with jellies, cubes, vibrant colors, puzzle challenges, explosive blast moments, and endless chances to win rewards and prizes while riding along with the coolest jelly crew around.

description:
The world is shrouded in crime. Cities teem with gangs, smuggling rings, and assassin syndicates — citizens live in fear. As the newly appointed police chief, you must start small and strategically expand a local precinct while safeguarding the city. Grow your reputation step by step: expand office space, establish new departments, streamline paperwork, recruit elite officers, and equip your team with top-tier gear to tackle increasingly complex cases. Transform a modest station into a prestigious law enforcement headquarters!

1. Design & Build Your Police HQ
Build an empire of justice from the ground up! Freely arrange facilities such as interrogation rooms, holding cells, and armories to optimize investigations. Every brick you lay brings the city closer to order.

2. Recruit Officers & Upgrade Gear
Assemble a dream team of elite officers to dismantle criminal schemes. Invest resources in advanced weaponry and vehicles to handle escalating threats.

3. Investigate Cases Strategically
Intimidation or incentives? Choose interrogation strategies and adapt your approach to each suspect. As your caseload grows, you’ll face off against notorious criminals and deploy SWAT teams to bring them to justice!

4. Manage Inmates
More inmates mean more federal funding, but they also require meticulous oversight. Classify inmates by risk level, assign them to segregated housing, and maintain vigilant patrols to prevent jailbreaks.

5. Crush Prison Riots
Poor meals, cramped cells, or lax surveillance can spark violent uprisings. Mobilize rapid-response teams in riot gear to suppress them before they tank your reputation and funding!

Key Features:

Strategic Depth: Balance budget, reputation, and security in a dynamic crime ecosystem.
Progression System: Evolve from a rundown precinct to a high-tech law enforcement center.
Realistic Challenges: Adapt to gang wars, hostage crises, and corruption scandals.
Can you bring the streets back from the brink? The city’s fate rests in your hands.

Looking for a relaxing puzzle game with real ASMR sounds? 
 Welcome to 3D Colorful Sort™ Magic Water! Join our clever raccoon on a fun puzzle journey to train your brain!
 Sort water, match colors, and solve each color puzzle. 
 This is the perfect mix of a calming ASMR experience and an addictive water sort challenge. Sort the colorful water, unlock beautiful wallpapers, and enjoy a fantastic puzzle adventure.
 
 How to Play the Water Sort Puzzle 
 The rules of this color sort puzzle game are easy to learn, but the puzzle gets tricky as you go:
 • Tap any glass to pick it up, then tap another to pour the water smoothly. 
 • The water can only be poured if it perfectly matches the top color and there is enough space to sort it. 
 • Sort the water until every glass holds only one pure color to win the puzzle game. 
 • Plan your puzzle moves to exercise your logic and brain! If you get stuck in the water puzzle, use magic tools to Undo a sort step, Shuffle the color water, or Add an extra tube to keep the fun going in this addictive sort game.
 
 Unique Color Sort Puzzle Challenges 
 Every stage brings an addictive water puzzle experience with mechanics that test your sort logic: 
 • Special Shapes: Pour color water into beautifully designed whale and rose containers for a fun puzzle experience. 
 • Hidden Cloths & Ice Blocks: Guess the hidden colors under cloths and break through freezing ice to keep sorting the water. 
 • Locked Cabinets & Roller Blinds: Find keys to unlock tricky water sort puzzle setups and roll up blinds to reach the color water. 
 • Color Tags & Mystery Water: Solve dense mini-levels and question-mark water color layers. Can your brain beat these ultimate color puzzle challenges?
 
 Your Water Sort Puzzle Companion 
 Every water puzzle you solve advances your sort adventure journey map. Clear color sort levels to unlock amazing dynamic home screen wallpapers featuring your magic raccoon friend. This adorable companion brings fun to the puzzle game experience, celebrating every time you make a perfect color sort match. Collect these dynamic backgrounds and enjoy a relaxing water sort puzzle journey!
 
 Real ASMR & Relaxing Color Sort 
 We built this water puzzle game for players who need to relax with ASMR. Listen to the crisp clink of lifting a glass and the highly realistic sound of pouring water. Enjoy the satisfying rustle of a cloth unveiling and the cheerful chimes of coin collection. Combined with smooth 3D visuals, every color sort move provides a relaxing vibe and an addictive puzzle workout for your brain.
 
 Fun Water Puzzle Events & Rewards 
 Join exciting in-game color sort events to make your puzzle adventure even more rewarding: 
 • Car Race & Magic Jump: Compete with other players to solve the water sort puzzle game fast, maintain a win streak, and share massive rewards. 
 • Puppy Soar & Potion Streak: Keep a winning sort streak going to send a cute balloon puppy flying, earning you infinite stamina for the puzzle game! 
 • Magic Quest & Lucky Spin: Complete specific color puzzle tasks to collect magic stars, open chests, spin the lucky wheel, and claim daily rewards to boost your water sort journey.

Relaxing Water Sort Puzzle Game With no time pressure, 3D Colorful Sort™ Magic Water offers a highly relaxing ASMR experience and great puzzle brain training. Sort the water, match the colors, and enjoy your fun color sort puzzle adventure!

description:
Welcome to Amaze GO! A clean arrow puzzle game built to calm a busy mind. Every arrow points the way — what you need to do is to choose the right order. The design cuts visual noise, reduces chaos, and helps you organize thoughts as you play. Pick up an arrow. Find its lane. Repeat until the grid is yours. Enjoy the quiet flow offline anywhere and anytime. 

What makes Amaze GO! great
1. Simple arrow mechanics, zero visual noise
2. Works offline with a clean interface that keeps attention on the board
3. Calm play loop for smart brains: think clearly, move each arrow with strategy
4. Smooth tap controls, clear path feedback, and satisfying release moments like ASMR
  
How to Play
- Find an arrow with a free path to the edge
- Tap to slide that arrow off the grid and open a lane for the next move
- Plan the order to secure a safe route and a clean board
- Long-Press to use Guidance to highlight directions when your path is unclear
- A wrong tap costs a heart for the level
- Clear the board to finish the level and aim for a perfect run
- Hints help focus when the grid feels tight
  
Why love this arrow puzzle
· Simple rules, profound strategy, and a meditative arrow puzzle
· Short breaks ease stress and sharpen focus
· The last arrow leaves the board with a satisfying mental reset
· Cognitive workout for sequencing and brain teasers
· Quiet visuals, plus a satisfying whoosh as each arrow flies off the grid — feedback that soothes instead of nags

Made for the in-between moments
- The ten minutes before a meeting starts 
- The metro ride too short for a podcast 
- The flight where your signal drops
- The wind-down after a noisy workday 
  
Amaze GO! - Puzzle Games is a calm arrow puzzle made for sharp minds and calm moments. Learn fast, then master timing and order. Send every arrow off the board, untangle the grid, and feel disorder turn into clarity. Amaze GO! is the puzzle you reach for when the rest of the day was too loud — one good move, then another, then a quiet board. Download now, plan smart paths, keep hearts safe, and enjoy pure focus anytime, anywhere!

description:
The town of Hidden Town is scared. Very strange things are happening. Villagers claim to have seen the figure of a girl who looks out from the window of one of the houses. Which is very strange, because that house has been abandoned for 20 years.

The Girl in the Window is Dark Dome's first point and click game that would begin the series of a dark town called Hidden Town surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this escape the room suspense thriller game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room in this escape puzzle.
This is the introduction to two of our most beloved characters from the Hidden Town universe: Dan and Mia.

You can play the Dark Dome escape room games in any order, you will be able to see how the stories are connected in each chapter to reveal the mysteries of Hidden Town. This is our first episode and it has connections to our fourth escape puzzle game: The ghost Case.

- What you will find in this horror escape mystery game:
A room surrounded by puzzles, objects that move by themselves and characters that come to life. Observe the entire environment to be able to solve mystery case.
An interesting detective story with a lot of mystery and an unexpected plot twist. You won't believe the revealing ending.
A deep and dark art that will make you feel part of this horror mystery adventure from beginning to end.
A complete hint system that can guide you through this interactive detective story whenever you find yourself trapped.

- Premium version:
This escape the room game has a Premium Version with which you will access a secret scene in which you will play an additional Hidden Town story with extra riddles and puzzles. It will also remove all ads from the haunted house game, giving you access to all hints directly without seeing ads.

- How to play this suspense thriller game:
Interact with objects in the environment by touching them. Find hidden objects and inventory items in the game or combine them with each other to create a new item to help you continue the story.
Test your wits with these haunted house escape puzzle.
Unravel the Horror Mystery: Dare to Dive Deeper

Are you brave enough to unravel the secrets that lie hidden within the walls of the haunted house? With its gripping suspense thriller storyline and hair-raising atmosphere, this point and click escape puzzle promises an unforgettable gaming experience that will leave you breathless with anticipation.

“Immerse yourself in the enigmatic stories of the Dark Dome escape games and reveal all its secrets. There are still many mysteries to be unraveled in Hidden Town."

description:
20 years ago there was a horrible murder in Hidden Town, and the murderer was never caught. In recent days, detective Ren Larsen has received strange messages from the afterlife. Apparently the souls of the victims cannot rest in peace and want to be heard. They need the person responsible to pay for what he did. Ren has a bad feeling but decides to reopen and solve mystery case. Will he be able to find the murderer?

The Ghost Case is the fourth episode of the Hidden Town escape room games series. You will have to go through different parts of the city investigating and looking for clues that will help you solve mystery case. Interview the suspects involved and discover the murderer.

All the Dark Dome escape room games can be played in any order, among them there are connections that will take us through various paths until we unveil all the mysteries of Hidden Town. This horror escape mystery game has a direct connection to The Girl in the Window and then Haunted Laia.

- What you will find in this suspense thriller game:

A map with which you can explore various points of the city. You can visit the murder house, the asylum, the cemetery, the police station, the magic shop and the houses of Dan and Mia's friends, within all these places you can find a lot of puzzles and brain teasers.

An intriguing and suspenseful interactive detective story. Develop your detective skills to the maximum to find the murderer.

Grim, detailed art and a great selection of music will make you feel like you're in a suspense thriller.

Two different endings that will depend on the decisions you make at the right time.

An alternate achievement: Find all 9 owls hidden throughout the entire detective story game. They can be in the least expected place, so look for them everywhere.

A detailed hint system in case you need help at any time. They will guide you to continue with the escape puzzle adventure.

- Premium version:
The Premium Version of this horror mystery game contains a secret scene where you can play a side story of Hidden Town with additional puzzles and riddles. By purchasing this version you will have access to this scene and, in addition, all ads in the suspense thriller game will be removed. That is, you will be able to see all the hints directly without seeing ads.

- How to play this horror escape mystery game:
Like in a classic point and click escape puzzle game, interact with objects and characters in the environment by touching them. Find hidden objects, use the inventory items on game objects or combine them to create a new item to help you continue on the detective story adventure. Put your wits to the test and solve the puzzles and riddles.

Experience a Horror Escape Mystery Like Never Before

Immerse yourself in the spine-tingling atmosphere of horror mystery puzzle, where every shadow hides a lurking terror and every creaking floorboard sends shivers down your spine. Prepare to be captivated by a narrative that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end.

Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a 2D dungeon hack-and-slash RPG featuring SNES-style pixel art and sound.
A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system.

§ Exploration
Players will explore six dungeons, navigating with a unique system where visibility of corridors and enemies depends on the character’s “vision".
Dungeon Antiqua 2 uses a symbol encounter system—you can avoid battles by dodging enemies, or strike first and take the initiative. The path forward is yours to carve through skill and decision-making!

§ System
In addition to the eight jobs from the previous game, two new classes—Monk and Archer—have been added, bringing the total to ten.
Earn skill points from victorious battles; once they reach the required threshold, you’ll unlock job-specific skills.
Since changing jobs does not reset level, you can freely experiment with multiple jobs to create your own ultimate party!

§ Concept
Sometimes, why not take a step back and return to the cartridge era of gaming?
By stripping away excessive story cutscenes and focusing on short, simple dialogue and text, the world is designed to spark your imagination—inviting you to create your own personal adventure.

§ Playtime
For a first playthrough, we estimate a playtime of approximately 10-12 hours.

§ About "Dungeon Antiqua" series
This game takes place hundreds of years after the story of Dungeon Antiqua.
You may even come across some familiar characters from the previous game…

description:
Mahjong Master: Logic, Strategy, and Brain Training

Mahjong Master is a classic tile-matching game designed for those who love a mental challenge. While the rules are familiar, the experience is strictly about logic and strategy. Unlike casual relaxation games, we treat every level as a unique puzzle to be solved.

Dive into intricate tile structures where every move counts. This game is your daily gym for the mind, designed to improve pattern recognition, boost memory, and refine your problem-solving skills through pure, classic gameplay.

How to Play: Your goal is to dismantle intricate tile structures by identifying and matching pairs of "free" tiles that aren't blocked on the sides or top. This requires more than just tapping; you must use a sharp eye and a strategic mind to plan your moves carefully. By peeling back layers systematically and avoiding dead ends, your objective is to clear every single tile from the board to solve the logic puzzle and master the challenge.

Why You'll Love Mahjong Master:

Pure Puzzle Satisfaction – Experience the thrill of "cracking the code." Each layout is a logic puzzle that requires you to find the right order of matching to win.
Serious Brain Training – Designed to keep your mind active and agile. Perfect for seniors looking to prevent memory loss or anyone wanting to test their IQ.
Classic & Authentic – No distractions. Just you and the traditional Mahjong tiles. We focus on the essence of the classic board game experience.
Sharp & Clear Visuals – We use Extra Large Tiles with high-contrast symbols. The interface is clean and crisp, ensuring you never miss a match due to poor visibility.
Progressive Difficulty – Starts easy to help you learn the logic, then ramps up to complex, multi-layered structures that will truly test your patience and skill.
Strategic Tools – Stuck on a tough layer? Use Hints to find hidden pairs or Undo to correct a mistake. Use tools to learn, not just to win.
Play Offline – Train your brain anywhere, anytime. No Wi-Fi required.
Mahjong Master isn't just a game; it's a test of your cognitive skills. If you enjoy the satisfaction of solving problems and keeping your brain sharp, this is the game for you.

Ready for the challenge? Download Mahjong Master now!

Contact us at support@pandasofcaribbean.com for support or feedback. We'd love to hear from you!

description:
Welcome to 10 Downing Street. You're the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom in this satirical strategy game for people who think they could do better. Try not to get sacked.

A crisis lands on your desk every month. Pretty much everyone is on strike. Your Chancellor has done something you're hoping the press don't find out about. The Daily Reckoning has turned. You have seconds to respond but every decision might please one faction and infuriate another.

Four groups hold your fate:
- Cabinet: Your inner circle. Lose them, lose control.
- Backbenchers: Your own MPs. Several have started a WhatsApp group.
- Media: They were briefly on your side. That was a different week.
- Public: Patient, mostly. They remember the big decisions.

Let any faction hit zero and it's over. A new Prime Minister inherits your mess and the world remembers every decision you made.

FEATURES
- 400+ political crises
- Multi-part storylines where your choices echo forward
- Timed decisions under pressure
- General elections, second terms and escalating instability
- The Chief Mouser chase is on, find it in the PM History Corridor
- Custom PMs - change your portrait, name and party colour
- Each PM continues where the last one fell
- The Queen of the Humber leadership challenge
- Reshuffles to help you stay in power
- PM history, records and portraits of your fallen leaders
- The Daily Reckoning newspaper reacts to your every failure
- Game Centre achievements
- Optional Special Adviser Pack with impact previews, longer timer, crisis log and post-crisis briefings

THE WORLD REMEMBERS
Each Prime Minister continues where the last one fell. Decisions echo forward. A bad call from the first PM can land on your successor's desk. The longer Britain has been ungoverned, the harder it is to govern.
Survive a term and face a general election. Win a majority and carry on into a second term, with harder crises, and a party that is starting to wonder if someone else might do it better. Lose and it's over. Britain moves on. It always does.

HOW LONG WILL YOU LAST?
Your record as PM will be remembered. The epitaphs are not kind. Your portrait will hang in a corridor no-one visits but you can do better than that. Maybe.

A work of satire. All characters, crises, and political parties are entirely fictional. Any resemblance to actual governance is purely coincidental.

description:
Colorever: a relaxing gem sorting puzzle where every tap reveals sparkling pixel art.

Tap a gem and watch its whole cluster glide home, one shining piece at a time, until a bright gem art picture is complete. No timers. No energy system. No fail screens. Just you, the gems, and a calm little puzzle you can always solve.

HOW TO PLAY

• Tap a gem, move a cluster. Every connected gem of the same color is picked up together, then flies to its matching space one by one.
• Read the board. Each space shows the color of the gem it is waiting for. Match gem to space and it locks in with a satisfying click.
• Use the tray. Two roomy rows hold the gems you are not ready to place yet, so sorting stays strategic, never frustrating.
• Reveal the picture. Place the last gem and watch the full pixel art scene light up, saved forever in your gallery.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT

• Genuinely relaxing. No countdowns, no energy system, no pressure. Play one puzzle on a coffee break or twenty in a row.
• Satisfying gem sorting. Move the colors around, organize the design, and watch order emerge one gem at a time.
• Always solvable. Every level has a solution, so getting stuck is temporary, never fatal.
• Gentle learning curve. The first puzzles teach themselves. Later boards are wide, layered and worth real thought.
• Handy helpers. Extra tray space, undo, hints, and a smart tap that tidies up the easy gems for you.
• Made to feel good. Crisp gems, glowing diamonds, soft sound and gentle haptics on every placement.
• Play offline, anywhere. No connection needed. Pause mid-puzzle and pick up hours later, exactly where you left it.

A GROWING GEM GALLERY

Hundreds of pixel art pictures to complete — animals, food, flowers, cities and cozy little scenes — with fresh sets added regularly. Every finished picture joins your gallery, so your gem art collection keeps growing as you play.

FOR FANS OF

Gem sorting and color sort puzzles. Pixel art and coloring games. Diamond art and diamond painting. Zen brain games and calm logic puzzles. And if you love color by number, Colorever is a fresh twist on the same relaxing feeling.

Take a breath. Tap a gem. Let the art shine.

description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

Key Features
• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

• Notes before purchase
This game is a work of fiction.
However, it depicts certain uncomfortable aspects of reality.
We suggest that you only play this game
when you feel confident that doing so would not overwhelm you.
If you ever feel overwhelmed while playing, please prioritize your well-being and take a break.

• Story
It's just another morning for this young girl. She wakes up and starts getting herself ready while shaking off the sleepiness like always. Except something, somehow, feels off.

When she steps into the living room, she expects to find her dad preparing for work. Instead, she finds a stranger sleeping on the couch.

The man wakes up, looks at the girl, and sighs. Ignoring her confusion, he mumbles to himself with a hint of sadness in his voice.

"It's really time to get ready."

Scared, the girl runs. She must leave the house.

She doesn't know who this man is or where her father has gone.
Walk alongside her on this twisting, twisted path and see where it will lead her.

Recommended for you if:

• You love analyzing the story through character dialogue and direction
• You want a short but deeply immersive, movie-like experience
• You're looking for an adventure game (visual novel) with simple controls and no complex actions

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

description:

This is a puzzle game designed for moments of focus and relaxation. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or enjoying a quiet break, the smooth flow and satisfying interactions make it easy to settle in and keep playing.

HOW TO PLAY
- Move pieces to complete parts of a picture
- Connect matching fragments to reveal the full image
- Clear completed sections to make room for new pieces
- Watch fresh tiles fall into place as the puzzle evolves
- Think ahead and manage your space to keep progressing

The mechanics are simple at first, but each level introduces new layouts that encourage thoughtful play and gentle strategy.

GAME HIGHLIGHTS
- A New Kind of Jigsaw Experience
The falling system adds movement and rhythm to traditional puzzles, creating a more dynamic way to play.
- Smooth and Satisfying Gameplay
Every connection feels rewarding, with clean visuals and responsive controls that make each action enjoyable.
- Beautiful Picture Collections
Explore a wide range of scenes, from nature and everyday objects to artistic compositions, all designed to be visually pleasing.
- Play at Your Own Pace
No timers, no pressure—just a relaxed environment where you can enjoy solving puzzles in your own time.
- Designed for Focus and Relaxation
A great choice for players who enjoy quiet, thoughtful gameplay that helps clear the mind.

Each level offers a fresh layout and a new way to approach the board. As pieces fall and the puzzle shifts, you’ll find yourself naturally adjusting your strategy and discovering new patterns.

Whether you play for a few minutes or a longer session, the experience remains smooth, rewarding, and easy to return to.

Download Jigsaw Drop: Solitaire Puzzle and enjoy a relaxing puzzle journey where every piece falls into place.

description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

description:
You're a traffic officer on patrol. Every car you pull over hides a story — and some drivers are lying right to your face.

Duty Patrol is a narrative decision game where you investigate, interrogate and judge. Read the case, question the driver, and catch the contradiction before you make the call. Can you tell the guilty from the innocent?

HOW YOU PLAY
• STOP & FIRST LOOK — The reason on the card is only the surface. It's up to you to uncover the truth.
• INTERROGATION: THE LIE ARENA — Ask the driver questions and read their answers. Some lie, some are innocent. Catch the contradiction.
• GATHER EVIDENCE — Up to 2 tools per case: document check, measurement, vehicle scan, drone, police database.
• MAKE THE CALL — Three verdicts: Release, Fine or Detain. Be fair — punishing the innocent costs you.
• REPUTATION & RANKS — Correct calls build reputation and earn coins. Run out of reputation and you're dismissed.
• BRIBES — Some drivers offer an easy way out. Take the risk... or keep your badge clean.

FEATURES
• 100+ hand-written cases across 13 categories: speeding, drunk driving, unlicensed drivers, smuggling, stolen vehicles, wanted suspects, document fraud and more.
• A pure deduction engine — no two shifts feel the same.
• Fast mini-games: car chases, radio codes, tow-truck precision, intersection command.
• Full support for 5 languages.
• Play offline, anywhere.

Every stop is a puzzle. Every lie is a trap. Can you serve justice on the road?

Outside the tracks, there’s a Bar with three minigames where you can try your luck and earn extra cash to invest in your car.

And the engine sounds? They’re a show on their own. Each car has its own unique and realistic roar, both at idle and full throttle.

If you’re into real drag racing, building projects, and that raw Brazilian car culture vibe, this game is for you.

description:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!

何十メートル落ちても大丈夫。足場につかまり直して、また登ればいいだけです。途切れるのは、ふたりそろって谷底まで落ちたときだけ。だから何度でも笑って、何度でもやり直せます。

◆ 空の色が、進んだ距離を教えてくれる
渓谷、風の庭、雲上の遺跡、黄金の空へ。背景は登るほどに移り変わり、ロードも待ち時間もなく景色だけが変わっていきます。100mごとの到達表示が、静かに背中を押してくれます。

◆ 10種類以上の仕掛けが待っている
動く床、昇降リフト、ジャンプ台、崩れる足場、氷の床、沈む床、消える床、横風。さらにふたりでないと越えられない協力ギミックも。シーソーは重心で傾き、スイッチ橋はふたつのスイッチでつながり、回転床は40秒かけて一回転し、風の谷は10秒周期で吹き荒れます。同じ登り方は、二度とできません。

◆ 相手は、世界のどこかの誰か
オンラインならランダムマッチで見知らぬ相棒と、フレンド招待やパーティーコードなら友だちと。言葉は交わせなくても、ロープの引っぱり方だけで気持ちは伝わります。最高到達点はランキングに記録され、世界中の挑戦者と並びます。

◆ まずは、ひとりで
「一人テスト」なら、相棒なしで操作とギミックをじっくり練習できます。記録はオンラインとは別に保存されるので、気兼ねなく何度でも。

■ 遊び方

1. 画面の左側を好きな位置からドラッグして、左右に移動します。
2. 画面の右側をタップしてジャンプ。スティックは触れている間だけ現れるので、画面をふさぎません。
3. 右側を長押しすると、ロープを引き寄せられます（オンライン協力プレイ）。
4. 足場に着地したら踏ん張って、相棒を引き上げましょう。空中では左右に振って足場へ戻れます。
5. 高度は、ふたりのうち低いほうの足元で計測します。置いていかず、置いていかれず。
6. 出発地点より45m下の谷底へふたりとも落ちると挑戦終了。結果を確認して、0mからもう一度。

さあ、綱を結んで。行けるところまで、いっしょに。
